name: Magnum Gas Storage Header Pipeline
researcher_notes: Not an existing row. The only Magnum row, P0304 (WEST Header, cancelled), is a different 650 mile concept. EIA May 2026 release, sheet Natural Gas Pipeline Projects row 74: Magnum Gas Storage Project, status Applied, in service 2030, 61.6 mi, 36 in, 1200 MMcf/d added, FERC docket CP25-233-000. The Aug 2026 release no longer lists the project (the URL named in the queue does not contain it); reason not found, so recheck. Federal Register notice of 6 May 2025 (FERC) states the project has a 61.6-mile, 36-inch header pipeline in Millard, Juab and Utah counties, Utah, tied to Kern River and Questar Pipeline. The header is already authorized under the earlier certificate (CP10-22, amended CP16-18, partly vacated CP20-77); the 2025 amendment asks to redesign caverns and extend the construction deadline. Add-threshold met: sponsor Magnum Gas Storage LLC, endpoints in Utah near Goshen, FERC application with environmental review done, 61.6 mi above the 15.5 mi length rule. Status set to proposed. Start location, ProjectLevelCost and route not found; no route research done. Owner has no existing entity; Parent not sourced so left blank. Two sources are the EIA release and a Federal Register notice, which is a partly independent pair. Capacity is incremental header capacity per EIA only. Medium tier, not green, because the EIA release is the only source for capacity and for the 2030 date.
